reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.quote: # Analysis design: paired tumor RNA–protein–metabolite data for a reproducible treatment-associated program
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.

checks.quote: # Analysis design: paired tumor RNA–protein–metabolite data for a reproducible treatment-associated program
checks.reason: A presence matrix and feature harmonization are given, but no independent sample identity/pairing integrity check.

checks.quote: single-sample enrichment-style scores of Δ
checks.reason: Scores are already constructed from paired deltas, yet validation asks for a program delta without defining the exact score transformation/orientation and paired contrast. The quantitative endpoint and denominator need an unambiguous formula.

checks.quote: # Analysis design: paired tumor RNA–protein–metabolite data for a reproducible treatment-associated program
checks.reason: Factor-count and preprocessing sensitivity have no bounded candidate range or procedure deriving search bounds and stop before confirmation.

checks.quote: concordant → retain metabolomics
checks.reason: Significant correlation/CCC with the original confounded deltas is not a sufficient bridge gate: original batch bias can persist, and a valid rerun can legitimately disagree. Require balanced-rerun effect/uncertainty and calibrated absolute agreement or quantified bias, not only correlation above a null.

checks.quote: # Analysis design: paired tumor RNA–protein–metabolite data for a reproducible treatment-associated program
checks.reason: Hashing the frozen archive is useful, but immutable raw-input hashes, exact environment/commands and full sample/file/output linkage are absent.

checks.quote: within discovery data only
checks.reason: Imputation/scaling are restricted to discovery as a whole, not explicitly refitted within every training fold/bootstrap used for selection and internal validation.

checks.quote: within-patient timepoint-label permutation
checks.reason: The null preserves pairing but not time-linked assay batch effects; conditional exchangeability or a justified balanced subset is required. Pattern-mixture sensitivity is otherwise useful.

checks.quote: # Analysis design: paired tumor RNA–protein–metabolite data for a reproducible treatment-associated program
checks.reason: No clean-environment numeric reproduction, output tolerances or resource/failure/source-difference logs.

checks.quote: # Analysis design: paired tumor RNA–protein–metabolite data for a reproducible treatment-associated program
checks.reason: A concrete staged assay/bridging design with patient-level power/detectable-effect planning, blinded randomized reruns, missingness scenarios and locked external validation. New attempts explicitly require new data. The bridge acceptance rule, exact score definition and training-only preprocessing remain problematic.
